verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You dance over me
While I am unaware
You sing all around
But I never hear the sound

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Lord, I'm amazed by You
Lord, I'm amazed by You
Lord, I'm amazed by You
How You love me

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
You paint the morning sky
With miracles in mind
My hope will always stand
For You hold me in Your hand

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
How wide (How wide)
How deep (How deep)
How great is Your love for me

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You've been so, so good to me
You've been so, so good to me
Oh to think where I would be
If not for You
If not for You

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
You are my portion
You are my inheritance and my cup
You are my portion
Surely the lines have fallen to me in pleasant places
